items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: Nelson Riddle did the Ronstadt record.

ctx.x: I had a quote from you from our conversation a year ago on the phone, you said, “We never got out of the sound box.” But I can’t remember what the context was. I think you’re talking about that. And were you referring to – Linda Ronstadt did a –
Right. Yeah. Nelson Riddle did the Ronstadt record.

I think it’s very interesting that other people heard that you had a sound but you weren’t aware of it. It’s almost like critics naming styles of music but the musicians don’t know. I mean not that they don’t know but musicians were playing bebop but they didn’t call it bebop until the critics did.
